variety.label: Norwegian Bokmål
variety.policyNoteEnglish: Bokmål verbs have the same finite form for every person and number. This catalog teaches infinitive, present, preterite, and present perfect. One conventional written variant is displayed where Bokmål permits alternatives.

review.noteEnglish: Original AI-authored and AI-reviewed Bokmål forms and English cues; native-speaker review remains required. No human approval is claimed.
